authorizedProduct.providerFeeCents: must be read from the captured provider transaction

implementation.scope: Opt in the owned test store without changing other merchants or reinterpreting already-created payment intents.
implementation.capture: Stripe platform-owned payment, with no immediate destination transfer or application fee. Preserve the existing secure widget and payment intent lifecycle.
implementation.allocation: Freeze buyer fee, merchant fee, recipient, account identity and window before provider creation. Read actual provider fees and conserve every cent across platform, merchant and provider.
implementation.retention: Payment approval creates awaiting_fulfillment. Proven CompletedOrder.fulfilledAt starts exactly seven days; incomplete, cancelled, refunded or disputed orders cannot release. No other marketplace or bank days are added.
implementation.payout: One durable claim and source-bound provider transfer. Unknown submissions are reconciled by GET without a second POST; a pending source reservation is not marked released.
implementation.rails: Stripe card implemented. The existing Asaas platform-transfer executor is reused when captured funds are available. Current Mercado Pago split is immediate and cannot be advertised as honoring this policy.
implementation.activation: Validate persisted sandbox states and current provider eligibility before activating the owned test store. Other merchants and old payment intents retain their frozen routes.

validation.paidOrders: customer action required after retention is ready
checks: real charge approval and persisted order
bank payout distinct from platform-to-merchant transfer

objective: Schedule the merchant split exactly seven days after product receipt or service completion, then validate the two customer payments.
